items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: He says, Solomon gave it to him.

ctx.x: Now -- yeah, one thing. You know we've mentioned Joe Thomas several times, and you said that (inaudible). Of course, you don't really sound alike in a sense. You both have a lot of drive but --

Stanley, he impressed me from simplicity. And I am a simple player. I don't play a lot of notes. And this is what I mean when he influenced me. Joe couldn't make a modulation (inaudible), say just take a thing. I'm going to give you a situation that he did. If -- you remember the tune, Cheating On Me. And Joe made a modulation on his horn. He played the solo. He said, la-da-doh-dah, da-dah, do-dee, doo-dat, hot-dod, do-da-da-da-da-dee-da-do-dah-yawp, pa-doodle-doo-doo-dah. He said, la-hi-do-dee-do-da,…
